evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' accepts arguments without type validation

rationale: Python type hints are not enforced at runtime. A caller passing an int where a str is expected will not trigger a runtime error without an explicit check. Type validation catches these mismatches deterministically.
remediation: Add isinstance() checks or use Protocol/ABC for structural validation.

guidance.explanation: The correct version validates types with isinstance() before use. The incorrect version trusts type hints which are not enforced at runtime in Python.
